name: motta-statusline
description: Two-line status line: folder, repo link, git state, the branch's PR with CI, conflicts and review, model and effort, a context bar with the auto-compact point, rate limits, tokens and the generation rate (tokens per second, live while a request streams). Below the prompt (always visible) or as a band above it.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: below: in the hint line under the prompt, visible while Claude works (terminal and desktop). above: a colored band above the prompt that the spinner replaces during a turn and other mods can take over.
